citation: Pulgarin-Giraldo J.D., Alvarez-Meza A.M., Melo-Betancourt L.G., Ramos-Bermudez S., Castellanos-Dominguez G. A Similarity Indicator for Differentiating Kinematic Performance Between Qualified Tennis Players. LNCS 10125, pp. 309-317, 2017. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-52277-7_38
notes: No racket markers in the source: racket orientation follows the recorded wrist rotation, calibrated to the expected contact pose at impact. Converted by mocap/export_tennis_mocap_bvh.py.
frame: origin = racket head centre at impact; x = horizontal racket-head velocity at impact; y = up; z = hitter right; metres; t in s from impact; 50 Hz
